title: Elf Bar Plus50 Watermelon Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Watermelon from the Elf Bar Plus50 pod range delivers a clean and subtly sweet vape inspired by ripe Watermelon. This flavour is soft, mellow, and fresh on the draw, lifted by a hint of coolness on the exhale that keeps things smooth and refreshing without overpowering the fruit. Each pod holds 2ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid and pairs with a 10ml refill reservoir, enabling up to 5,500 puffs per pod. The mesh coil design ensures reliable performance, smooth vapour and satisfying flavour—perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vapers using the Elf Bar Plus50 Kit.
